subject: Local deployment of Shiny apps where R is not install?

messages.author: 8a60646b2d1a7245
messages.subject: Local deployment of Shiny apps where R is not install?
parts:
Hi

I happened to encounter PortableApps.com on SorceForge and this software allows a user to install applications on a portable or cloud drive.

Although it hasn't been checked if it can create applications on a cloud drive (eg Google Drive) yet, it is definitely possible to create an application on a portable drive - some software such as Firefox, Notepad ++ and SQLite Database Browser are provided by the company at the moment.

My interest is to look into if it would be possible to create Shiny apps on a cloud drive so as to prepare reports for clients who haven't installed R in their local machines.

Since I don't have a suitable background to carry on this kind of investigation, it would be appreciated if a comment is given.

Thank you.

Regards
Bernie
